sisyphus.name: Sisyphus
sisyphus.headline: Every click moves Sisyphus one step up the hill.
sisyphus.description: The boulder always rolls back. But you keep going. A click counter with mythology wrapped around it, turning fidgeting into a story.

just_ten.name: Just Ten
just_ten.headline: Hold the button for exactly 10 seconds.
just_ten.description: Looks like a reaction game. The expanding circle quietly syncs your breathing, grounding you mid-stress without anyone noticing.

flappy_bird.name: Flappy Bird
flappy_bird.headline: The classic, on your Click.
flappy_bird.description: One button, one bird, infinite pipes. Pure tactile fidget, no touch screen, no ads, no algorithm.
